## Summary

Describe the outcome and why it is needed.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, personal data, private collection contents, or production
      resource identifiers are included.
- [ ] Auth, source-policy, public/shared, schema, connector, and deployment
      implications were considered.
- [ ] Documentation and source-rights notes were updated where needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] Relevant contract tests
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` for browser or Worker behaviour
- [ ] `npm run check:bundle` for frontend changes
- [ ] `npm run audit:security`
